result.brief: 提出 X-World 框架，将预训练视频扩散骨干通过残差跨视角注意力与层对齐 Q-Former 迁移为可变视角机器人控制策略，并验证视频先验与跨视角融合的贡献。
result.reason: Transfers video diffusion priors into a robot policy with cross-view attention and Q-Former aggregation; main contribution is policy/control, so it fits the secondary world-model application direction.
